'''2003 Pennsylvania State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Pennsylvania (26 April 2003).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Pennsylvania
* '''Dates:''' 26 April 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Venue:''' Pittsburgh Comic Con, Monroeville, Pennsylvania<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Dan Tartaglione]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Drew Ferguson]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
